description: Benchmark dataset for empirical validation of concept combination mathematical models and LLM semantic synthesis.

concept_u.name: Navier-Stokes Equations
concept_u.description: Non-linear partial differential equations describing the conservation of momentum and mass in viscous fluid flow.

concept_v.name: Deep Neural Networks
concept_v.description: Parameterized non-linear function approximators optimized by gradient descent via reverse-mode automatic differentiation.

ground_truth_blend.name: Physics-Informed Neural Networks (PINNs)
ground_truth_blend.isomorphism: Automatic differentiation compute graphs mirror spatial differential operators; PDE residuals penalize the loss function directly as physical conservation laws.
ground_truth_blend.emergent_property: Mesh-free solving of inverse fluid problems without numerical discretization grids, enforcing Navier-Stokes physics into weight updates.
ground_truth_blend.falsifiable_test: Forward simulation of lid-driven cavity flow and boundary-layer vortex shedding with exact loss convergence on zero labeled internal velocity points.

concept_u.name: Natural Selection
concept_u.description: Differential reproductive success of phenotypes over generations driven by mutation, crossover, and fitness pressures.

concept_v.name: Heuristic Combinatorial Optimization
concept_v.description: Algorithmic strategies for searching complex, NP-hard discrete solution spaces with high dimensionality.

ground_truth_blend.name: Genetic Algorithms
ground_truth_blend.isomorphism: Bit strings or candidate parameters map to chromosomes; objective function evaluation maps to biological fitness; parameter swaps map to genetic crossover.
ground_truth_blend.emergent_property: Stochastic exploration-exploitation balance overcoming local optima traps in non-convex fitness landscapes.
ground_truth_blend.falsifiable_test: Performance benchmarking against hill-climbing on De Jong test suite and Traveling Salesperson Problem (TSP) landscapes.

concept_u.name: Shannon Entropy
concept_u.description: Logarithmic measure of uncertainty and transmission capacity across discrete classical channels: H(X) = -sum p(x) log2 p(x).

concept_v.name: Quantum Superposition & Density Matrices
concept_v.description: State vectors in Hilbert spaces whose non-commuting observables and entanglement produce density operators rho.

ground_truth_blend.name: Von Neumann Quantum Entropy & Qubit Theory
ground_truth_blend.isomorphism: Diagonal elements of density operator rho map to classical probability distributions, generalized by trace S(rho) = -Tr(rho log2 rho).
ground_truth_blend.emergent_property: Entanglement entropy where a composite system is in a pure state yet each subsystem has non-zero positive entropy.
ground_truth_blend.falsifiable_test: Verification of subadditivity S(A, B) <= S(A) + S(B) and violation of Bell inequalities in entangled Bell state channels.

concept_u.name: Hierarchical Bayesian Inference
concept_u.description: Recursive updating of prior probability distributions over latent parameters conditioned on evidence likelihood.

concept_v.name: Cortical Sensory-Motor Hierarchy
concept_v.description: Ascending feedforward sensory pathways and descending feedback regulatory connections across cortical laminae.

ground_truth_blend.name: Predictive Processing & Free Energy Principle
ground_truth_blend.isomorphism: Descending corticocortical projections convey top-down generative predictions; ascending projections transmit only prediction error residuals.
ground_truth_blend.emergent_property: Unified explanation of perception and motor action (active inference) as dual minimization of variational free energy.
ground_truth_blend.falsifiable_test: Mismatch negativity (MMN) electrophysiology in auditory cortex response to oddball deviant tones.

concept_u.name: Ising Spin Glass Model
concept_u.description: Lattice of interacting binary magnetic spin dipoles seeking thermodynamic equilibrium at minimum Hamiltonian energy.

concept_v.name: Content-Addressable Associative Memory
concept_v.description: Retrieval of complete stored memories from incomplete, noisy, or corrupted sensory cues.

ground_truth_blend.name: Hopfield Recurrent Attractor Network
ground_truth_blend.isomorphism: Binary neuron firing states (+1, -1) map to Ising spins; synaptic Hebbian weights map to magnetic exchange coupling constants J_ij.
ground_truth_blend.emergent_property: Lyapunov energy function ensuring monotonic convergence into stable local energy minima (attractor basins) storing target patterns.
ground_truth_blend.falsifiable_test: Storage capacity testing up to the theoretical limit of p_max ~ 0.14N patterns before catastrophic spin-glass retrieval breakdown.

concept_u.name: Backpropagation Algorithm
concept_u.description: Application of calculus chain rule to compute loss gradients with respect to neural network weights.

concept_v.name: Stochastic Gradient Descent (SGD)
concept_v.description: Iterative optimization stepping in the negative gradient direction using mini-batches.

concept_u.name: DNA Transcription
concept_u.description: Synthesis of RNA molecules from DNA templates by RNA polymerase.

concept_v.name: RNA Translation
concept_v.description: Decoding of mRNA transcripts into amino acid polypeptide chains by ribosomes.

two_silo_benchmark.description: Two distinct clusters (Silo A: Physics/Fluids vs. Silo B: Neural Networks) connected only within themselves. Demonstrates COMPARTMENTALIZED regime with near-zero lambda_2.
